name: Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP)
description: Hands-on penetration testing certification demonstrating mastery of information gathering, vulnerability identification, privilege escalation, and active exploit development.

name: Certified Red Team Operator (CRTO)
description: Specialized red teaming qualification focused on adversary simulation, Cobalt Strike operations, lateral movement, domain dominance, and defense evasion.

name: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
description: Globally recognized cybersecurity certification validating expert capability to design, implement, and manage a best-in-class cybersecurity program.
